issue.title: Typed-admission errors repeat per unit and partial-launch drops joined error
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `src/sase/axe/chop_runner_script_result_launch.py` and `src/sase/axe/_chop_lifecycle_runner.py`

Typed-admission error aggregation repeats an identical lease-failure message once per unit, which made the 2026-09-22 06:37 error digest 25 KB. Separately, the partial-launch branch drops the joined error before the digest.

Evidence: `~/.sase/axe/error_digests/digest_20260922_063743.txt` (25,005 bytes). Error 3/3 (`toobig_split[sase]`) lists the same `operational workspace lease failed during preparation: git@ssh.github.com: Permission denied (publickey)` text for typed admission units 1-35. Found while implementing the approved `202609/service_host_ssh_credential.md` plan; explicitly out of scope there — do not fix it as part of that plan.

Repro: trigger a credential failure during a typed-admission launch (e.g., stale `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` as on 2026-09-22) and inspect the newest `digest_*.txt` under `~/.sase/axe/error_digests/`. The `toobig_split` section repeats the identical per-unit message instead of aggregating once.

Impact: hourly error digests balloon (25 KB in the observed case) and partial-launch failures lose the joined error, making triage noisy and incomplete.

task_type_fields.repro: Trigger a credential failure during a typed-admission launch and inspect the newest digest_*.txt under ~/.sase/axe/error_digests/; the toobig_split section repeats the identical per-unit lease message (see digest_20260922_063743.txt, 25KB).
